name: Montecatini Terme (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Montecatini Terme (a yellow lion above waves on blue) within branches, with the motto SALVS on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Montecatini Terme, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Montecatini Terme arms — yellow lion above waves on blue, crowned, within branches, with motto SALVS
